writing.title: Marathon D1 · Task 1.1 — Swimming pool closure (letter to a friend)
writing.prompt:
You are a member of a local sports and leisure center. You received an email from the center manager.

Dear Member,

From next month, our swimming pool will be closed for approximately three months while essential repair work is carried out. As part of the project, we will also create a larger and more modern fitness area. The work will be expensive, but members will not be asked to pay any additional fees.

We understand that the closure may affect some members and would be grateful to receive your views and suggestions.

Kind regards,
The Center Manager

Part 1.1
Write a letter to your friend, who is also a member, telling them about the closure, giving your opinion, and suggesting what the center should do. Write 50–70 words.

writing.title: Marathon D1 · Task 1.2 — Swimming pool closure (letter to the manager)
writing.prompt:
You are a member of a local sports and leisure center. You received an email from the center manager.

Dear Member,

From next month, our swimming pool will be closed for approximately three months while essential repair work is carried out. As part of the project, we will also create a larger and more modern fitness area. The work will be expensive, but members will not be asked to pay any additional fees.

We understand that the closure may affect some members and would be grateful to receive your views and suggestions.

Kind regards,
The Center Manager

Part 1.2
Write a letter to the center manager expressing your views on the planned changes and suggesting how the center could support members while the swimming pool is closed. Write 120–150 words.

writing.title: Marathon D2 · Task 1.2 — Email to a language school
writing.prompt:
You saw this advertisement:

EVENING ENGLISH COURSES at Bright Future Language School
Small classes · Experienced teachers · Courses start in September
Write to us for more information!

Task 1.2
Write an email to the school director. Say why you want to study English, and ask about the timetable, the price and the size of the classes. Write 120–150 words.

writing.title: Marathon D3 · Task 2 — Online discussion — school uniforms
writing.prompt:
You are participating in an online discussion. The question is:

Some people think that all students should wear a school uniform. Others believe that students should be able to wear what they like. What do you think?

Post your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.

writing.title: Marathon D4 · Task 1.1 — Message to a neighbour
writing.prompt:
You received this message from your neighbour:

Hello! Sorry to bother you. I'm going away for a week and I need someone to water my plants and feed my cat. Would you be able to help? Please let me know if you can, and tell me if you have any questions.

Thank you,
Mrs Davis

Task 1.1
Write a message to Mrs Davis. Say whether you can help and ask two questions. Write 50 words.

writing.title: Marathon D5 · Task 1.2 — Letter to the council
writing.prompt:
You received this notice from your local council:

The council is planning to close the city centre to cars every Saturday. We would like to hear the views of local residents. How would this change affect you? What do you suggest?

Task 1.2
Write a letter to the council. Explain how the change would affect you and suggest what the council could do to help residents. Write 120–150 words.

writing.title: Marathon D6 · Task 2 — Online discussion — city or countryside
writing.prompt:
You are participating in an online discussion. The question is:

Some people prefer to live in a big city, while others think the countryside is a better place to live. Which do you think is better?

Post your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.

writing.title: Marathon D7 · Task 1.1 — Message to a colleague
writing.prompt:
You received this message from your colleague:

Hi! Our team meeting is on Friday at 10 a.m., but the manager wants to move it to Thursday afternoon. Is that OK for you? If not, what time would be better? Please reply today.

Thanks,
Alex

Task 1.1
Write a message to Alex. Say whether Thursday afternoon is possible and suggest another time if necessary. Write 50 words.

writing.title: Marathon D2 · Task 2 — Public sports facilities (online discussion)
writing.prompt:
You are participating in an online discussion. The question is:

Some people believe that local governments should spend more money on public sports facilities, such as swimming pools and sports centres. Others think this money should be spent on other services, such as healthcare and education. What is your opinion?

Post your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
